baseline_evidence.old_render_version: not recorded in generation report; cannot claim exact engine-version matching

shader_policy: Principled BSDF; UV->neutral Mapping->linear repeat image nodes. Color sRGB; roughness/GL normals Non-Color; tangent normal strength 1. No displacement, AO, added sheen/anisotropy/coat. Per-source metallic values frozen in registry; development uses original metallic map/value. No geometry or map appearance adjustment by model outcomes.

quota_policy.replacements: None after this freeze. A failed/unavailable source blocks the complete endpoint; document the failure. Any replacement requires a new versioned pre-score registry, family review and full balanced protocol, never a hidden swap. Never replace or omit hard-but-valid images.
quota_policy.retry: Technical interruptions may resume only identical fingerprints and valid PNGs. Corrupt/orphan outputs fail closed; quarantine the entire incomplete run and rerun unchanged protocol. No overwrite/force flag.

qc_policy.old_pilot: One alphabetically first original TRAIN material/class, one view each; parent runs EEVEE on its scheduled GPU. CPU smoke is engineering verification only, not matched-render validation. Do not score fresh holdout before old pilot data-only review.
checks: all source hashes and official provenance
exact 21 sources and 30 unique indices each
complete RGB PNG decode and checksums
no blank, near-all-black, near-all-white or missing-texture-magenta image
qc_policy.eligibility: Ceramic restricted to provider-described fired-clay/quarry/glazed tiles (no marble/terrazzo). Concrete restricted to bare/brushed/board-formed cementitious surfaces (no plaster/paint). Thus not directly interchangeable with the old ambiguous taxonomy. Metal is a substrate label; coating/rust and constant-metallic approximations remain domain limitations.
qc_policy.sample_limitation: Only three source groups per class. Thirty correlated renders do not supply thirty independent source samples. Scanned suede leather can visually resemble textile. Provider metadata cannot prove undisclosed common physical origins.
